en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large ornate pavilion in a landscaped park. The building has a prominent glass and metal dome, rich classical decoration on its façade, arched windows, statues and ornamental reliefs. Small trees line the front, and paths with benches and lampposts lead toward the entrance. In the top corners, red printed text identifies the city and the building.
